problem1.time_convention_basis: User confirmed official-template start labels with daily cyclic midnight mapping on 2026-09-11

problem3.forecast_mode_basis: Inherited from the Problem 2 selected policy (trend forecast, quantile 0.80, greedy buffer, 48 h planning)
problem3.external_weight_basis: Equal-weight combination of the attachment 3 release and the in-house trend forecast. Fixed after inspecting the full-year PV error diagnostics (attachment 3 alone, in-house alone, equal blend) and before any cost replay; never changed on cost results. 'A priori' therefore refers to the cost replay, not to the error diagnostics
problem3.quantile_basis: 1 - marginal acquisition price / emergency price: plan 1-1/5, upward 1-1.5/5, downward 1-0.5/5
problem3.settlement_basis: Plan billed in full; upward part at 1.5p; defaulted part billed at the 50% default price (0.5p of its charge returns). 'penalty' keeps the full charge and adds 0.5p
problem3.information_chain_basis: Review round 1 (R02/R07, 2026-09-12): the newest release's next-day coverage enters the advisory day (issue_time + 1..144 slots; slots beyond the coverage keep the in-house lead-2 forecast; no next-day release is read), and calibration residuals rebuild the intraday load-bias correction for every completed day. Adopted as the main version by the pre-registered rule that the published version is the one whose stated information set matches its implementation; the frozen legacy chain, cross-day-only and matched-bias-only variants are reported with identical inputs, initial state, controller and settlement

problem4.price_method_basis: Equal-weight average of (i) the mean of the two most recent same-weekday price profiles and (ii) a per-slot regression of price on net load fitted on the last 56 completed days and applied to the in-house net-load forecast. The components were compared on the January 8-31 error check and the combination was then fixed; a priori relative to the February-December cost replay, not relative to the January comparison; the equal weight was never tuned
problem4.intraday_basis: Mean deviation of the observed same-day prices from the day-ahead forecast is added to the remaining slots at each release
problem4.settlement_basis: Plan, adjustment and emergency bills use the realized attachment 4 price of the delivery slot; the future price is unknown at decision time
